[[Ring of Fire Island Chain/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | pic3 = [[File:Fire Islands signpost.jpg|175px]] | pic3-text = Ring of Fire Islands [[signpost]]. }} {{Quotation|prophecies|Just south of the [[Tarnished Coast]] lie the volcanic islands that together make up the Ring of Fire. The large volcano at the center of the ring is where the gods reportedly dropped the [[Bloodstone]]s before leaving [[Tyria]] for good. Of the islands that surround this one, many are still active. Ships that pass by the Ring report hearing the tell-tale hiss of scalding hot lava hitting the ocean, instantly vaporizing the saltwater into steam. The reefs off the islands are formed of black pumice stone. There are very few natural ports, and those that might be suitable for docking would bring the crew of the ship within danger of being caught by a sudden, unexpected eruption. There are no known settlements in the Ring of Fire.}} The [[Ring of Fire Islands]], also called '''Komalie's Rest''',Prophecies Prima Guide, pg. 175 are the home of one of the five bloodstones, and of the volcano known as [[Abaddon's Mouth (landmark)|Abaddon's Mouth]]. No known sapient species are native to the islands, and the only permanent structures present are defensive structures created by the [[Mursaat]]. The most notable of which is the [[Onyx Gate]], a large fortress designed to defend the [[Door of Komalie]] and keep its inhabitants sealed. It is said that the volcano, Abaddon's Mouth, is possessed, which causes the formation of various monstrous faces and skulls across the islands.[[The Art of Guild Wars]] Despite the islands' seemingly constant volcanic activity, flora manages to thrive along the more temperate regions at the edges. A variety of trees, bushes, and grasses can be found throughout the island chain, though the burnt remains of forests serve as a reminder that the environment is far from hospitable. Many creatures manage to thrive in the hostile environments, including [[Rider]]s, [[Arachnid]]s, [[Dryder]]s, [[Drake]]s, [[Wurm]]s, [[Behemoth]]s, and [[Abomination]]s. ==Towns and outposts== *[[Ember Light Camp]] ([[outpost]]) '''Mission outposts:''' *[[Abaddon's Mouth (outpost)|Abaddon's Mouth]] *[[Hell's Precipice (outpost)|Hell's Precipice]] *[[Ring of Fire (outpost)|Ring of Fire]] ==Missions== *[[Ring of Fire]] *[[Abaddon's Mouth]] *[[Hell's Precipice]] ==Explorable areas== *[[Perdition Rock]] ==Landmarks== {{landmark list|Ring of Fire Islands}} ==Soundtracks== *Guilds at War *''[untitled]'' *Abaddon's Mouth *The Door of Komalie ==Gallery== File:"Lava Tunnel" concept art.jpg File:"Lava Tunnel" concept art 2.jpg File:"Lava Tunnel" concept art 3.jpg File:"Volcano" concept art 1.jpg File:"Volcano" concept art 2.jpg File:"Volcano" concept art 3.jpg File:"Volcano" concept art 4.jpg File:"Volcano" concept art 5.jpg File:"Volcano" concept art 6.jpg File:"Volcano" concept art 7.jpg File:"Titan's Prison" concept art.jpg ==Trivia== {{gw2w|Ring of Fire}} *The Ring of Fire Islands are also called: **Fire Islands **Fire Island Chain **Ring of Fire **Ring of Fire Archipelago **[[Captain Grumby|Ring of Fire Island Chain]] *Stone skull structures similar to those in the Ring of Fire Islands can be seen in [[the Fissure of Woe]], [[Gate of Torment]] and [[Depths of Tyria]]. *The name may be based on the [[W:Pacific Ring of Fire|ring of fire in the pacific]]. *The [[signpost]]s carry a map of [[Tyria]]. ==References== {{Continents nav}}
